title: Admin notice vendors
description: The plugins whose admin notices a site owner may choose to hide, and which code directories identify each. An allowlist: a plugin absent from this file cannot have its notices hidden by Debloater, no matter what a user types. Each entry says plainly what selecting it silences, because Debloater cannot tell a vendor's marketing apart from its warnings and does not pretend to.

slug.description: What the user selects. Also the parameter value the generated runtime receives.

name.description: What the vendor calls itself, shown in the interface.

sources.description: Plugin directory slugs whose notice callbacks this entry covers. A callback is hidden only when the file it is defined in lives in one of these, so a vendor cannot silence anything but its own code.

notes.description: What selecting this vendor actually hides, including what a person might miss. Shown on the tweak, not buried in a changelog.
